## Welcome to the projects!!!!!!!!!!!!

im here to announce that this project is a palce to connect, collaborate, and share

## what is this projects?
this project is a local first media optimizer and converter. il allows you to convert standart images (PNG, JPG, JPEG) and video MP4 (MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI) to webm directly in to ur browser. all processing is client side, ur files never leave ur device

### Its fully open source to everyone
This project is completely open source, and we welcome everyone:
* **Curious users**: Just want to try it out? Let us know your thoughts or share feedback!
* **Idea generators**: Have a feature request or a suggestion to improve the UI? Post it here!
* **Developers & Contributors**: Want to contribute code? Check out the contribution guidelines in the [README](https://github.com/SERAVEEM/Image-Converter-/blob/main/README.md) and jump right in!
Feel free to introduce yourself below, share what you're working on, or ask any questions!
